description: Parsed transaction history for a Solana address — human-readable, enriched tx feed (swaps, NFT sales, transfers) with a plain-English description, type, source protocol, fee, and timestamp for each transaction. Deeper than a raw signature list. Example: helius_parsed_transactions({ address: "86xCnPeV69n6t3DnyGvkKobf9FdN2H9oiVDdaMpo2MMY", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Helius API key (free 1M credits/mo at helius.dev)

address.description: Solana wallet or program address (base58), e.g. "86xCnPeV69n6t3DnyGvkKobf9FdN2H9oiVDdaMpo2MMY"

name: helius_parsed_transactions
title: Helius Parsed Transactions
